messages.content: If people still have models being tested after the deadline (e.g. in a scenario where you submit a hour before deadline but it doesnt finish for another 5 hours after the deadline) will it be counted or not? If it is going to be counted, and we didnt choose a model, and this model has the highest score of our models, will it be automatically chosen? This question bugged me for a while.
